narrative.overview:
The site is a case file opened on black: flat dark surfaces stacked in a fixed order, each holding evidence, and one gold mark reserved for numbers that came out of a measurement. The world is elayadesign's landing-page-design system (Part B), pinned by the owner on 2026-11-03 and run under impeccable's process. It is Geist alone, named text styles on the Tailwind scale, spacing from a fixed 2 to 96 px token set, Tailwind radii with nested-radius math, full 1px borders, a floating blurred pill nav, and a white to grey gradient on each page's top heading.

Density is calm and wide: a 1312 px page, 96 px between sections, and panels that hold content with an 8 px shell so media sits inside with the nested radius. Motion is weighted and decelerating (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`): content rises 32 px and fades in once, tabs cross-fade with an 8 px rise, and the tagline lights word by word. Everything honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.

The site is dark only. Print is the one exception: the print stylesheet turns the page into a clean black-on-white CV. Rejected worlds (the IBM Carbon "report and instrument" pass and the "launch film" graphite cinema pass) are not to return.
keyCharacteristics: Flat black ground (#000000) with three stepped surfaces and full 1px borders; no shadows.
One face, Geist, used only through named text styles.
Spacing only from the 2 to 96 px token set.
Gold appears only on measured figures, and every figure sits beside its limit.
Floating blurred pill nav; panels nested at 16 px outside, 8 px inside.

rules.name: The Measured Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold (#E5C04A) marks only a number that came out of an evaluation. Not links, not icons, not headings, not decoration, not hover states.

rules.name: The Number With Its Limit Rule
rules.body: A measured figure never appears without its limit in the same view (PRODUCT.md principle 1). On the home page every case-file tab's limit ends above 900 px.

rules.name: The Dark Only Rule
rules.body: There is one theme, dark. Do not add a light theme or a theme toggle; only print flips to black on white.

rules.name: The Named Style Rule
rules.body: Text is set only through the named styles (heading-1 to heading-6, title-1 to title-5, body-1 to body-6, button-lg/md/sm, caption-1 to caption-5). No ad hoc sizes.

rules.name: The Upright Rule
rules.body: Nothing is italic. `em`, `i`, and `cite` render upright, including the Specter quotes.

rules.name: The Copy Is Harvey's Rule
rules.body: Dates are written like LinkedIn ("Jun 2026 - Sep 2026"), and project titles are set exactly as Harvey wrote them. The system does not restyle or rewrite either.

rules.name: The Fixed Spacing Rule
rules.body: Every margin, padding, and gap comes from the 2 to 96 px tokens (2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 80, 96). No values between steps.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: To lift something, move it one surface step up and give it a full border. Never add a drop shadow.

rules.name: The Blur Order Rule
rules.body: Write `-webkit-backdrop-filter` first and the unprefixed `backdrop-filter` after it; the production minifier drops the unprefixed one otherwise. Do not give the nav its own view-transition name, or the blur stops seeing the page.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Inner radius = outer radius minus padding: 16 px panel, 8 px padding, 8 px inner. The method inset nested in the research panel is sanctioned by the pin and follows the same math.

dos: Do set every page's top heading in the white to grey text gradient (#ffffff to #9b9b9b, left to right); that heading is the only gradient on the site.
Do keep gold (#E5C04A) for measured figures, and place each figure's limit in the same view.
Do take every space from the 2 to 96 px tokens and every radius from the Tailwind set, with inner radius = outer minus padding.
Do set figures in tabular numerals.
Do write dates like LinkedIn ("Jun 2026 - Sep 2026") and keep project titles as written.
Do reveal content once, rising 32 px over 700 ms on the weighted ease, and drop the movement under reduced motion.
donts: Don't add a second typeface, italics, or sizes outside the named styles.
Don't add drop shadows; lift with a surface step and a border.
Don't use gold on links, icons, headings, hovers, carets, or decoration.
Don't add a light theme or a theme toggle.
Don't put a gradient anywhere but the top heading's text: no gradient fills, borders, or backgrounds.
Don't add eyebrows or kicker labels above headings.
